data.content: Folé is a school dedicated to providing quality education and fostering student growth. We helped rebrand the school by creating a fresh identity, including a modern logo and visual style.
When Folé Residence launched as a modern student accommodation provider, we crafted their brandbook, logo, and social media posts.
Our focus was on showcasing their cutting-edge facilities and dynamic environment, positioning Folé as the ideal choice for vibrant student living.
Our approach to designing Folé Residence’s brand was driven by the desire to create a welcoming and comfortable atmosphere for students.
We used soft baby blue and warm yellow tones, complemented by playful baby chick designs, to evoke a sense of safety and warmth.
This color palette and visual style aimed to make students feel at home while reflecting the lively, supportive environment of the residence.
Folé aimed to grow their social media presence, and with our tailored social media strategy, we went beyond expectations.
Our creative approach helped drive rapid engagement, turning their platform into a dynamic hub for student life and beyond.
A noticeable rise in social media engagement sparked curiosity among students, leading to an influx of inquiries.
Our playful yet sophisticated branding resonated with Fole’s target audience, establishing a strong online presence that fostered a sense of community and belonging.
